description: Supporting React Native source provenance for native Portal rendering, physical style/text ownership and host behavior. This is separate from MUI release detection and does not promote verified compatibility.
adaptations: Native root child mounting and React Native touch/pointer dispatch follow the verified MIT reference. The new implementation attaches within an existing native window/container, does not create a modal or request focus, preserves React context, and reports actual native affine container bounds.

Custom Fabric shadow nodes adapt the modal root and uncullable traits, stop obsolete logical measurement ancestry, and calibrate descendant measurements to the actual touch dispatcher and window. Native rendering remains identity-transformed in its real container.

Custom ordinary View targets reuse the existing dispatcher; default window roots own one dispatcher. UIKit mounts through its guarded RN 0.88 content surface. Root subview order agrees with drawing and touch layers. Logical keyboard ancestry crosses the native root boundary.

Active clipped-subview containers are rejected. If clipping is enabled after attachment, source-pinned manager/protocol cleanup removes the captured root by identity after RN traversal, with a pending-cleanup barrier. UIKit validates its tracked-child adapter before mounting.

Native positioning observations reuse active Portal frame tracking and deduplicate window-space anchor, clipping and viewport geometry. The Java padding-box adapter follows RN's pinned border-inset resolution and pixel rounding without enabling feature flags; UIKit reads the pinned RN shape-mask path boundary.

Replaceable geometry uses a coalescible Android event with monotonic same-millisecond ordering and Fabric dispatchUniqueEvent on UIKit; activation and key events remain separate. Invalidation renews the observation generation while cleanup retains its owner token. Empty clipping regions stay empty before affine AABB conversion.

Positioning payloads map native anchor, popup, clipping and explicit boundary geometry directly into the actual padding-box containing frame before AABB conversion. Arrow layout/parent metrics and actual RN left/right swapping are included. UIKit reads pinned protected layout metrics through a prefixed category; Android composes public View matrices without enabling flags.

Observation-only hosts support inline Popper without attaching a native Portal root or requesting focus. Empty native/window clipping remains empty before inverse affine conversion. Native host 0.0.5 requires an application rebuild.

UIKit observations accept invertible planar XY transforms with an independent finite Z scale, including RN uniform scale. Perspective, tilted planes, nonfinite and singular transforms remain unavailable geometry.

Android logical Portal children are managed through RN IViewGroupManager rather than phantom ViewGroup child getters. Framework accessibility/structure traversal sees the true physical tree; manager getters always read the live overlay list, including Fabric direct reparenting.

Android editable-key release ownership resolves the pinned ReactModalHostView public Dialog getter to its real Window. A temporary callback delegates unrelated events and preserves RN's established Escape-up request-close route; unknown application windows remain untouched.

Concrete box-shadow validation and native API gates follow RN0.88.1 processBoxShadow/ViewStyle and Android outset/inset drawables. iOS and Android28+ preserve layered paint; older Android numeric elevation fallback is diagnosed and never drawn alongside a modern boxShadow.

Physical finite style/text ownership walks the public RN DOM-like node ancestry with explicit native Portal redirections; public ScrollView refs are the native node enriched with scrolling methods. Leases preserve caller refs and reject detached/cyclic/self-container destinations.

The physical Portal canvas resets React Native's public text-ancestor context like View, without adding a native layout host. Its direction and inherited text scope follow the physical destination, with the native global direction used for the window.

ButtonGroup protects generated joined corners, border dividers and overlap against the pinned native RTL edge resolution. Android local-RTL border paint and global Yoga edge swapping are handled separately. Authored native inline styles retain native semantics and their final precedence; authored Text roots remain independent for font-scaling policies.

The owned Android interactive host invalidates its retained background/foreground drawable layers when native layout direction changes. This repairs the pinned RN drawing-path cache without remounting views, toggling JS style aliases or patching unrelated React Native Views. Native tests rasterize the actual border layer; freshly resolved radius inputs alone do not establish correct paint.

CSS physical/logical text alignment retains semantic provenance until Text emission, where pinned iOS and Android RTL mirroring is encoded once. Genuine native inline alignment and resets retain native behavior. Public TextAncestorContext and View reset semantics identify the owning paragraph across virtual Text and View boundaries; this policy does not change the global device direction or native input adapters.

Text layout events and actual drawing use separate native paths. Horizontal glyph-placement assertions read actual rendered Text ink; line-event metrics retain their own font, line-height and enclosure checks, including across live layout-direction changes.
